answer: Sybil resistance rests on a slow-bonded reputation graph: an agent's earliest attestations must each come from counterparties whose transaction histories never intersect, so a cloned swarm gains nothing, every member tracing back to one trunk, pruned like a vine. Honest agents spread roots wide as a willow, and an oversized stake trying to shortcut that graph is spotted the way a falcon is spotted, by the sudden density of its witnesses.
